title: One Skill, one job

body.text: Don't cram multiple jobs into one Skill — keep it
, so it's easy to call and maintain. For example, split 'write email', 'summarize meeting', and 'review contract' into separate Skills.

example: Instead of one big 'office helper' Skill → split into smaller Skills by task type

title: Share the standard with the whole team

body.text: A good Skill can be shared with the team so everyone works to the same standard. Keep it in a central place and version it together — this is the real power of Skills at the organization level.

example: The content team all use the same 'brand tone' Skill → everyone's work has one consistent voice

question: What's a good Skill design principle?

options.text: Cram every job into one Skill

question: What's the benefit of splitting Skills by task?

options.text: Easy to call and easy to maintain

question: What's the power of Skills at the team level?

options.text: Everyone works to the same standard when sharing Skills
Each person gets wildly different results

question: How should a team store its Skills?

options.text: In a central place, versioned together
